title: Packet retention-failure map: prune on discovery error, and index per delegation instead of scanning host-wide
outcome: Remembered packet retention failures are pruned against the live record even when retained-history discovery fails, and packet pruning touches only the requested delegation's entries.
acceptance: A packet visit whose retained-history discovery fails still drops that delegation's obsolete remembered failures (another attempt or a changed identity), while publication stays gated on successful discovery. Shown by a behavioural test.
The map is indexed by (canonical parent, delegation), with the attempt stored in the entry, so pruning does not scan unrelated delegations' entries.
